address: 34 Lombard Road, The Left Bank, London,SW11 3RF
bio: Hotel Rafayel on the Left Bank is part of Battersea's stunning and award-winning Falcon Wharf Development. Designed by architect James Burland, the unique and critically-acclaimed steel, glass and timber building provides a fitting home for this 5-star luxury hotel.  Enjoy fabulous views over The Thames whilst in the inviting dining rooms within Hotel Rafayel. Decked out with vibrant purples, gleaming wooden floors and colourful LED lighting throughout, Hotel Rafayel offers a truly unique ambience in such a charming location.  Afternoon Tea has arrived at Hotel Rafayel. Enjoy the sophisticated surroundings of the riverside restaurant as you are served savoury sandwiches, freshly baked scones with jam and clotted cream, and a selection of teas and cakes.
